rules_en: Rules: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, calligraphy, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No recognizable brands, franchises or existing characters. No weapons and no violence. If any people appear, they are small silhouettes seen from behind or far away, modestly dressed, and their faces are never visible. Never depict a prophet, a companion or any religious figure. Original artwork.
transparent_en: Transparent background (PNG), the subject fully isolated.

A.about_ar: مدينة عربية على جبال زي عمّان وقت المغرب وأول الليل. رسم قوي بخطوط سودا عريضة زي شاشات التحميل بالألعاب الكبيرة، والزخارف الإسلامية (النجمة الثمانية، المشربية) داخلة بالعمارة وبالضو. ألوانه: نيلي غامق، برتقالي وزهري للغروب، ذهبي ونحاسي، فيروزي. هاد اقتراحي لأنه بيجمع الإسلامي وإحساس GTA بالنص.
A.en: Style: premium illustrated key art in the spirit of a modern open-world game loading screen, completely original: confident thick ink outlines, cel-shaded painting with smooth gradients and a subtle grain, dramatic low-angle cinematic composition, strong readable silhouettes. World: an Arab hill city inspired by Amman, Jordan: stacked limestone houses on steep hills, long stairways, cypress and olive trees, domes and slender minarets, rooftop water tanks, warm window lights. Islamic geometric art (eight-point stars, girih, mashrabiya lattice, arabesque) is woven into the architecture, the light and the sky. Palette: deep indigo sky, a tangerine-to-rose sunset band, brass and gold highlights, lapis blue, turquoise tile glints, warm limestone beige. Light: warm lantern glow, crisp rim light, a few neon-like geometric accents in turquoise and magenta. Mood: confident, cinematic, hopeful, modest.

B.about_ar: هادي وراقي ونهاري: فسيفساء وأقواس وقباب ومقرنصات وذهب، أقرب للفن الإسلامي الكلاسيكي. إحساس GTA هون بيضل بس بالخط العريض وبلحظات الاحتفال جوّا التطبيق.
B.en: Style: refined, luminous editorial illustration with crisp shapes, fine detail and a light paper grain, rooted in classical Islamic art and architecture (Andalusian, Mamluk and Ottoman): zellige tilework, carved stucco, horseshoe and pointed arches, muqarnas vaults, courtyard fountains, gold-leaf ornament. Palette: ivory, lapis blue, turquoise, emerald green, terracotta and gold leaf. Light: soft morning sun with long gentle shadows. Mood: calm, elegant, spiritual, timeless. Clean composition with generous negative space.

C.about_ar: أقرب شي لإحساس GTA: غروب نيون زهري وبرتقالي وبنفسجي، خطوط سودا تقيلة، سرعة وحركة. واللافتات المضوية كلها زخارف إسلامية بدون ولا حرف.
C.en: Style: high-energy retro-futurist poster art: heavy black ink outlines, halftone and cel shading, saturated synthwave gradients (hot magenta, electric orange, deep purple, teal), dramatic perspective, motion light-streaks. World: an Arab hill city at night; its glowing signs are made only of Islamic geometric shapes (eight-point stars, arabesque curves, lattice) and never of letters; domes and minarets in silhouette against an enormous setting sun; car light trails winding up the hills. Mood: bold, fast, playful, cinematic.
